North Korea builds bridges to China and Russia

North Korea has inaugurated two new bridges, one connecting to China and another to Russia, signaling a deepening of ties with both nations. The bridge to China, located in the border city of Dandong, aims to boost trade and economic cooperation. The bridge to Russia, situated in the Rason Special Economic Zone, is intended to facilitate transit and logistics. These developments occur amidst heightened geopolitical tensions and North Korea's increasing reliance on its traditional allies.
